description: This Java source file defines the TestRunContainer class, which implements a container for running JUnit tests within the Apache OFBiz framework. It manages test initialization, execution, logging, and reporting, including handling test results and generating XML reports.

classes.name: TestRunContainer
classes.description: Implements a container to run JUnit tests, handle test execution, logging, and report generation within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: JunitXmlListener
classes.description: A listener extending XMLJUnitResultFormatter to generate XML reports for test suites, tracking start and end times.

classes.name: JunitListener
classes.description: Implements TestListener to log test start, finish, errors, and failures during test execution.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the container, sets up logging directory, retrieves test properties, and prepares the test suite wrapper.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the test suites, collects results, logs outcomes, and throws exception if tests fail.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Placeholder for stopping the container (empty implementation).

methods.name: setLoggerLevel
methods.description: Configures debug log levels based on user-specified log level.

methods.name: prepareJunitSuiteWrapper
methods.description: Creates and returns a JunitSuiteWrapper based on test properties; throws exception if no tests found.

methods.name: createJunitXmlListener
methods.description: Creates a JunitXmlListener for XML report generation, handling file output stream.

methods.name: logTestSuiteResults
methods.description: Logs summary and detailed errors/failures of test suite results.

methods.name: logErrorsOrFailures
methods.description: Logs individual test failures or errors.

methods.name: getTestName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a test, handling TestCase and other Test types.
